course_name: 自動化光學精密檢測及實習
outline: 本課程主要介紹自動化光學精密檢測相關技術，內容包括如下：前言，精密量測概論，機器視覺原理，二維光學檢測技術及實習，三維光學檢測技術及實習，影像處理與人工智慧技術運用，智慧型量測系統及應用，系統整合之相關技術，產業相關技術應用，及結論。
schedule:
Weeks	Hours	Subject Content
1	3	Course Introduction and arrangement
2	3	Introduction of AOI and its industrial application
3	3	Review of two-dimensional machine vision technology
4	3	Review of three-dimensional machine vision technology
5	3	Micro 3D measurement methods (I)
6	3	Micro 3D measurement methods (II)
7	3	Moiré 3D vision technology
8	3	Optical interferometry
9	3	Phase shifting interferometry
10	3	Middle Examination
11	3	White light interferometry
12	3	Industrial expert speech I: Optical Vision
13	3	Industrial expert speech II: Polarization-based measurement
14	3	Chemical AOI technology
15	3	LCD inspection
16	3	Fundamentals of color science
17	3	Special topics on AOI
18	3	Student Project Presentation (II)
assessment:
Marking criteria:
(1)	Home work and Lab work: 40%
(2)	Middle examination: 30%
(3)	Student Final project and report: 40%
